zoe_cs: Heads up — NewLeaf POC seeing brief 401s then a large 429 spike during their serverless warmup. Errors start ~20-35s after cold start. Can eng triage?
matt_eng: thanks. 401 -> 429 during warmup usually indicates ephemeral token refresh overlap + warmup fanout. Can you paste the exact warmup request + a couple lines of logs?
zoe_cs: Minimal warmup request they shared:
```
POST /v1/embeddings HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <ephemeral_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json
{ "model":"rwd-embed-2b", "input":"warmup" }
```
They rotate tokens every 30s and spawn 8 parallel warmup workers on cold start. After ~6 successful warmups we start seeing 2x 401s then a flood of 429s for ~60-90s.
alert-bot: metric alert: newleaf-poc (client: nl-88) 5m 429 rate jump 2% -> 41% at 3456789124. Top route: /v1/embeddings.
lucy_se: quick hypothesis: some refreshes return empty/short tokens -> 401. The client retries immediately and the concurrent retries plus other warmup traffic exceed per-key soft concurrency -> 429 cascade. Also check for accidental header truncation in their sidecar.
matt_eng: safe customer guidance we can hand off now:
1) Cache ephemeral token per-worker/process for >= 75s (avoid overlapping refreshes).
2) Add jittered exponential backoff for 401 responses instead of immediate retry.
3) Limit warmup parallelism: try maxParallelWarmups=3 or set maxConcurrency=4.
4) Log full Authorization header length during warmup to catch truncation.
Share this Node snippet: 
```
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  tokenProvider: cachedProvider({cacheMs:75000}),
  maxConcurrency: 4,
  authRetry: { attempts: 3, baseDelayMs: 200, jitter: true }
});
```
zoe_cs: copied. Customer says they can ship the SDK patch but want a fallback if patch doesn't land fast.
lucy_se: if they can't change quick, ops can temporarily: +2 soft concurrency for nl-88 and enable a 30-45s token-grace window for that key while they roll the fix. Ops approval required. This is temporary and we should document the timeline.
matt_eng: also recommend they debounce identical warmup calls on their sidecar for 1s — trivial change for serverless and reduces preflight load.
oliver_ae: FYI this POC is a renewal lead in 5 weeks. If onboarding stalls >48h escalate to AE. Please include me in the escalation.
zoe_cs: Plan: 1) Send the SDK snippet + debounce suggestion to NewLeaf now. 2) Request they deploy to staging and run 50 sequential warmups (no parallel) and report 429 rate after 20m. 3) If 429 rate >25%, request ops temporary cap bump. Call scheduled in 90m to review.
matt_eng: Action items: Matt -> ops escalation text ready if needed; Lucy -> short debounce how-to doc; Zoe -> customer message + call.
